shortDesc: The hydrodermabrasion and photon-light system behind our HydraFacial: eight standard and nine optional handles for cleansing, extraction, infusion, RF, microcurrent and LED.
intro: The Hydra Facial 8+9 is the system we use for HydraFacial sessions at Skin Essence in Kalyani Nagar. Built by BVLASER, it combines hydro dermabrasion and photon light in one trolley with a 10.4-inch touch screen, four serum bottles and up to seventeen treatment handles, which is why one session can move from deep cleansing to firming without changing machines.

The eight standard handles cover the core of a hydra facial: bubble cleaning, which uses a vortex of water and serum under vacuum to loosen dead cells and dirt; a skin scrubber and high-pressure spray for exfoliation and hydration; ultrasonic and bipolar RF handles for firming; microcurrent for a V-face lift; a five-pole light micro-electronics handle; and a cold hammer to calm the skin and close pores at the end.

Nine optional handles extend it further, including an oxygen revitalising bubble, spot clears, plasma, diamond microdermabrasion, an electric microneedle, an ultrasonic tip, electrotherapy, a four-pole roller and a colour LED mask. Dr. Daksha Patel decides which handles a patient's skin needs, so an oily, congested face and a dry, dehydrated one get different sessions on the same platform.
whatItTreats: Fine lines and early loss of firmness
Acne-prone skin that needs gentle, non-invasive care

howItWorks.title: Bubble cleansing and exfoliation
howItWorks.description: The bubble-cleaning handle draws a vortex of serum across the skin under vacuum, lifting dead cells and impurities, while the skin scrubber and high-pressure spray refine and hydrate.

howItWorks.title: Extraction and infusion
howItWorks.description: Vacuum clears blackheads without squeezing, then oxygen and serum are infused into the freshly cleansed skin from the four-bottle system.

howItWorks.title: Firming energy
howItWorks.description: Bipolar RF warms the deeper layers to stimulate collagen, ultrasound helps serums penetrate, and microcurrent tones the facial muscles.

howItWorks.title: Light and cooling
howItWorks.description: Photon light therapy calms acne-prone skin and supports repair, and the cold hammer closes pores and soothes the skin to finish.

faqs.q: Is this the same as the HydraFacial brand?
faqs.a: HydraFacial is a brand name owned by another company. Our machine is a BVLASER hydra facial system that performs the same hydrodermabrasion steps and adds RF, microcurrent, ultrasound and light therapy handles.
No. The treatment is non-invasive and bloodless; you feel cool suction and a gentle vibration, and most patients find it relaxing.

faqs.q: How long does a session take, and is there downtime?
faqs.a: About 45 minutes for the standard sequence, with no downtime. Skin may look slightly pink for an hour and looks brighter the same day.

faqs.q: How often should I have one?
faqs.a: Every 4 to 6 weeks keeps pores clear and skin hydrated. A single session works well 5 to 7 days before an event.
